candidate_decisions.reason: The focus presence-and-witness branch meets the assembled-group, gathering-place, and multitude carriers in 100:5, 100:6, and 100:11. The five supplied branches form one changed reading of witnesshood as participation in a gathered body, and every branch lands.

The focus expression branch meets the supplied human-in-the-pupil image in 100:6. Eye and tongue are distinct representational surfaces, producing a specific embodied reading rather than a repetition of generic testimony.

The focus birth-and-maturity-sign branch meets the pregnancy, wholeness, recent-birth, and maturity carriers in 100:5, 100:6, 100:8, and 100:11. The developmental sequence changes witnesshood into a sign appearing at bodily thresholds, while retaining every supplied branch.

The candidate has only the focus demonstrative, no registered branch, and unresolved ذ و و citations. Its reference function is supplied by the local focus grammar, but no independent macro carrier or context contact changes the reading beyond that local function.

The two focus testimony facets meet the supplied knowledge and report carriers in 100:9 and 100:11. Their contact makes a concrete movement from known content to public utterance, and all four branches land.

The focus testimony branch connects to the supplied appeal, liability, and compensation carriers across 100:1, 100:3, 100:10, and 100:11. The branches form a bounded adjudication-and-settlement mechanism rather than merely sharing a legal topic.

The focus indicator branch meets the supplied pupil, visible-complexion, and distinguishing-mark carriers in 100:3, 100:6, and 100:9. Together they make a specific sign system in which surfaces disclose an otherwise absent person or condition.

The focus comb-honey branch meets the supplied curd, thick syrup, and welcome-food carriers in 100:4, 100:6, and 100:11. The distinct food roles explain one another as a prepared provision, so the complete branch set is retained.

The focus expression branch meets the supplied lineage-attack, ugly-abuse, and angered-face carriers in 100:2, 100:4, and 100:9. The contact changes witnesshood into an expressive and bodily record of conflict, with all four branches landed.

The exact HFT trace links running and panting in 100:1 to the focus expression facet. Its involuntary-breath mechanism changes deliberate testimony into bodily self-disclosure; the unresolved context branches are retained as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace links concealed fire and striking in 100:2 to the focus indicator facet. The contact event supplies a real latency-to-visibility mechanism, so the unresolved context branches remain as attributed activations.

The exact HFT trace links alteration, morning visibility, stirred dust, and a remaining mark across 100:3-100:4 to the focus indicator facet. The resulting forensic-wake mechanism is materially distinct from a present observer and retains the non-dominant trace mapping as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace links entry into the middle of an assembled group in 100:5 to the focus presence facet. Spatial penetration supplies an insider vantage distinct from the broader multitude finding, and the unresolved middle-branch is retained as attributed.

The exact HFT trace carries the human subject from 100:6 into the focus and joins perception, nurturing relation, and enacted severance. The subject's condition becomes self-indicting evidence, with every supplied branch retained in attributed mode where unresolved.

The exact HFT trace joins the focus's expression and indicator facets to the heart, valued good, and binding intensity in 100:8. The durable attachment becomes its own confession, distinct from the legal and linguistic testimony findings.

The exact HFT trace links the focus indicator facet to the future uncovering, obscurity, and disclosure of 100:9. The trace supports a proleptic witness reading in which evidentiary status precedes public exposure, and all branches land as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace joins the focus testimony and indicator facets to extraction and the action-producing interior in 100:10. The inner archive mechanism materially changes present observation into retained, recoverable evidence.

The exact HFT trace joins the focus testimony facet to the explicit lordship and inward-knowledge predicates of 100:11. It creates nested human and divine epistemic roles rather than collapsing them, with the unresolved lordship branch retained as attributed.

The exact outlier trace uses the supplied split mappings for 100:1 and returns through the focus indicator facet. Repeated running is thereby read as countable, practiced recurrence; the mapping remains explicitly attributed and exploratory.

The exact outlier trace connects concealed and struck fire in 100:2 with the focus indicator and the heart's valued attachment in 100:8. The sterile-spark irony materially changes the reading and is retained with its cross-domain boundary.

The exact outlier trace links the focus comb-honey facet to extraction and the action-producing interior in 100:10. It yields a contained-substance mechanism distinct from the broader prepared-food candidate and remains exploratory.

The exact outlier trace links the focus birth-and-maturity facet to grave overturning and extraction in 100:9-100:10. The emergence-with-attendant-traces mechanism is distinct from future exposure and is retained with the explicit material-analogy boundary.

findings.title: Witness within a gathered body
findings.claim: Across the native pericope, the focus witness can be read as presence within a gathered body: a matter is witnessed from participation in an assembled social whole.
findings.mechanism: The focus form carries ready presence and direct seeing; جَمْعًا supplies both collection into one whole and an assembled group, while رَبّ is also supplied with a multitude-bearing use. Their contact turns isolated witnesshood into situated participation.
findings.reader_payoff: Witnesshood becomes a position inside a gathering, so the clause can disclose involvement as well as observation.
findings.containment: The ordinary assertion that the subject is a witness remains intact. The finding adds a gathered setting and does not assert a spoken summons, a particular ritual site, or a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The complete branch set and its cross-ayah carriers are supplied by trusted reviewed evidence; the integrated relation is a bounded macro inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir olayın ya da yerin yanında hazır bulunma ve onu doğrudan görme çekirdeği vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate carries presence together with direct witnessing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope places the focus beside an assembled group and a multitude-bearing lord term.
branch_activations.activation: Presence-and-seeing meets the gathered-body carriers, giving witnesshood an internal social location.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The subject witnesses from within a collected social whole.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus noun into a crowd or assert a ritual summons.

branch_activations.facet_statement: gathering scattered parts into one collected whole
branch_activations.carrier: جَمْعًا carries the collection of scattered elements into one whole.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus predicate supplies presence and witnessing as the relation to be situated.
branch_activations.activation: The collected-whole image gives the focus witness a single assembled object in which presence occurs.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witnessed matter is held together as one gathered whole.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim that every available gathering sense is active.

branch_activations.facet_statement: assembled group or mixed multitude
branch_activations.carrier: جَمْعًا carries an assembled or mixed group.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness clause supplies direct presence as the contact relation.
branch_activations.activation: The assembled group supplies a concrete collective interior for the witness's presence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood is located amid a gathered multitude rather than at an unspecified distance.
branch_activations.boundary: The group image supplements the clause and does not replace its witness predicate.

branch_activations.facet_statement: gathering-place, gathering-day, or summons
branch_activations.carrier: جَمْعًا carries the gathering-place or gathering occasion extension of assembly.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness supplies the presence that makes a place or occasion a witnessed setting.
branch_activations.activation: A gathering setting meets witnessed presence, making the matter locatable within a common scene.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness clause acquires a concrete gathering setting.
branch_activations.boundary: The evidence does not establish a particular day, place, or spoken call.

branch_activations.facet_statement: large group or multitude
branch_activations.carrier: رَبّ is supplied with a multitude-bearing extension in the surrounding pericope.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness and جَمْعًا supply the situated collective relation.
branch_activations.activation: The multitude extension enlarges the gathered setting around the focus witness without changing the ordinary referent of رَبّ.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witnessed gathering can be perceived as a large social body held under one relation.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual extension of the supplied branch, not a claim that the ordinary lordship sense disappears.

findings.title: Person carried by eye and tongue
findings.claim: The focus witness can also be perceived as an embodied surface through which a person becomes present: the eye carries a human image and the tongue carries the person's expression.
findings.mechanism: شَهِيدٌ supplies the expression-bearing tongue facet, while إِنسَانَ in 100:6 supplies the human-image-in-the-pupil branch. The eye and tongue meet as two surfaces that make a person available through reflection and speech.
findings.reader_payoff: The witness is no longer only an abstract role; the body itself becomes a pair of surfaces through which identity appears.
findings.containment: The ordinary witness reading remains recoverable. The eye image is a supplied lexical resonance, not a claim that the verse names an eye or that every human reference means a pupil image.

epistemic.reason: The eye and tongue branches and their paired context support are supplied by trusted reviewed evidence; their representational synthesis is bounded to this pericope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dil, konuşma ve sahibini belli eden ifade dalın çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate carries language and expression that identifies its owner.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding human term supplies the person whose presence can be represented.
branch_activations.activation: The expressive witness facet meets the human-image carrier, pairing spoken expression with embodied identity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The subject's witnesshood is a bodily way of making the person present.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not reduced to a literal tongue or to speech alone.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: the little human image in the pupil

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Identity is available through a visible reflection as well as through expression.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied image is a bounded extension of the human carrier, not a literal gloss of every occurrence of إِنسَانَ.

findings.title: Witness as a threshold sign
findings.claim: Within the pericope, witnesshood can be heard as a sign appearing at thresholds of retention, birth, wholeness, and mature strength.
findings.mechanism: شَهِيدٌ supplies the birth-and-maturity-sign facet; جَمْعًا carries retained pregnancy and wholeness, رَبّ carries recent birth and freshness, and شَدِيدٌ carries full maturity. The contact makes witnesshood an emitted or visible sign of developmental change.
findings.reader_payoff: A witness becomes something that appears when a hidden or retained state crosses into a new bodily condition.
findings.containment: The ordinary statement of witnessing remains primary. The supplied developmental images do not assert a literal pregnancy narrative, a female subject, or a universal biology of the focus clause.

epistemic.reason: The developmental branch set is fully supplied by trusted reviewed evidence and has a specific multi-ayah progression; the synthesis remains a bounded resonance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğum veya erginlik sırasında beliren bedensel madde, akıntı ya da iz dalın çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus witness predicate carries the supplied sign-at-birth-or-maturity image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope supplies retained pregnancy, recent birth, and full maturity carriers.
branch_activations.activation: The developmental carriers give the focus sign a threshold at which concealed growth becomes visible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood is perceptible as a sign accompanying developmental transition.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not equated with a literal bodily discharge or a single biological scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: a female state of retained pregnancy or virgin intactness
branch_activations.facet_statement: a female state of retained pregnancy or virgin intactness
branch_activations.carrier: جَمْعًا carries the supplied retained-pregnancy or intactness image.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: A retained state can already bear a sign whose meaning becomes visible at release.
branch_activations.boundary: The evidence does not assign a literal female subject to the focus.

branch_activations.facet_statement: wholeness without scattering or loss
branch_activations.carrier: جَمْعًا carries wholeness without scattering or loss.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sign is defined by an event that makes a condition legible.
branch_activations.activation: Wholeness supplies the retained state from which a developmental sign can be read.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness can mark a condition that has remained complete until its threshold appears.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual wholeness image, not a replacement for the ordinary group sense of جَمْعًا.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: animal just after birth and freshness
branch_activations.facet_statement: animal just after birth and freshness
branch_activations.carrier: رَبّ carries the supplied recently-born and fresh state.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sign supplies the perceptible trace of a threshold condition.
branch_activations.activation: Recent birth gives the developmental sign a concrete fresh-after-emergence state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus witness can mark a state newly brought into visible life.
branch_activations.boundary: The animal-after-birth image is not asserted as the literal subject of the ayah.

branch_activations.facet_statement: full maturity and strength
branch_activations.carrier: شَدِيدٌ carries full maturity and strength as a developmental endpoint.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness supplies the sign that makes a threshold state legible.
branch_activations.activation: Mature strength completes the movement from retained condition to visible capacity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood can be the mark by which completed strength becomes recognizable.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not become a claim that maturity is the only meaning of شَدِيدٌ.

findings.title: From known content to utterance
findings.claim: The focus witness can participate in a movement from known content to report and spoken expression: what is known becomes publicly available as testimony.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies knowledge-based testimony and an expressive tongue; يَعْلَمُ supplies knowing as something disclosed, and خَبِيرٌ supplies reported and inwardly tested knowledge. Their contact turns knowledge into a report carried outward by speech.
findings.reader_payoff: The clause shows how an inwardly known matter becomes hearable, not merely that a witness exists.
findings.containment: The ordinary witness predicate remains intact. This finding does not make the focus a legal formula or claim that every knowledge predicate is a spoken report.

epistemic.reason: The focus and context branches are supplied by trusted reviewed evidence with a clear knowledge-to-expression mechanism.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezde bilinen bir şeyi kesin haber veya açıklama olarak bildirme vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate carries testimony that makes known content definite.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The pericope supplies knowing and tested inward knowledge as the content to be made public.
branch_activations.activation: Knowledge meets testimony as the passage from held content to decisive report.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness clause presents known content on its way to public declaration.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not reduced to a formal courtroom statement.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dil, konuşma ve sahibini belli eden ifade dalın çekirdeğidir.

branch_activations.activation: The tongue facet gives the movement from knowledge to report a concrete expressive outlet.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood is the outward articulation of inwardly known content.
branch_activations.boundary: The expression image supplements, rather than replaces, direct witnessing.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.facet_statement: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus witness can carry both received report and knowledge of an interior matter.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied branch does not make the focus's subject identical with the explicitly named knower of 100:11.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: knowing a thing as it becomes clear
branch_activations.facet_statement: knowing a thing as it becomes clear
branch_activations.carrier: يَعْلَمُ carries disclosure of a thing to the knower.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus predicate supplies the testimony that can express what becomes clear.
branch_activations.activation: Disclosure becomes communicable through the focus's testimony and expression facets.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The report is a visible endpoint of something becoming known.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim that the focus clause alone contains the whole later disclosure scene.

findings.title: Witness within a claim and settlement
findings.claim: The focus witness can be situated in an adjudication movement: a grievance seeks redress, testimony and inward knowledge establish the matter, and liability is converted into compensation.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies testimony; عَٰدِيَاتِ is supplied with an appeal-for-redress branch, صُدُورِ with settling a liability on money, مُغِيرَاتِ with compensation in place of retaliation, and خَبِيرٌ with inward knowledge of the case. These carriers form a claim-to-settlement sequence that returns through the focus witness.
findings.reader_payoff: Witnesshood gains a practical consequence: it is part of how a contested matter becomes assessable and materially resolved.
findings.containment: The plain witness assertion remains present. The legal movement is an attributed contextual resonance and does not turn the ayah into a procedural legal ruling or choose between retaliation and compensation.

epistemic.reason: The supplied legal branches create a connected sequence with exact native carriers; the sequence is a bounded contextual synthesis rather than an ordinary translation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezde bilinen bir şeyi kesin haber veya açıklama olarak bildirme vardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate carries knowledge-based testimony.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding carriers supply grievance, liability, compensation, and inward case knowledge.
branch_activations.activation: Testimony becomes the evidentiary hinge between an appealed claim and its settlement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness clause can be heard inside a process that establishes and resolves a claim.
branch_activations.boundary: No specific human court, legal actor, or procedural rule is asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: appeal for redress
branch_activations.carrier: عَٰدِيَاتِ carries the supplied appeal-for-redress image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness supplies the testimony that can establish the appealed matter.
branch_activations.activation: A request for redress gives witnesshood a contested matter to clarify.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus witness stands where an injured party's claim seeks recognition.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary running image and its local sense remain available.

branch_activations.facet_statement: settling a liability on money
branch_activations.carrier: صُّدُورِ carries the supplied settling-of-liability image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus testimony and the inward-knowledge carrier supply the evidentiary basis for settlement.
branch_activations.activation: Testimony contacts material liability, moving the claim from statement toward settlement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The matter witnessed can have a material account that is brought to settlement.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not assert that صُّدُورِ ordinarily means money liability in the focus wording.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: legal compensation as an alternative to retaliation
branch_activations.facet_statement: legal compensation as an alternative to retaliation
branch_activations.carrier: مُغِيرَاتِ carries the supplied compensation-in-place-of-retaliation image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness and the liability carrier supply the case and its material consequence.
branch_activations.activation: Compensation gives the witnessed claim a form of resolution that changes the relation between injury and response.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The evidentiary movement can end in restitution rather than only in accusation.
branch_activations.boundary: The evidence preserves retaliation and compensation as live legal alternatives; it does not adjudicate them.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.facet_statement: knowledge by report and tested inner knowledge
branch_activations.carrier: خَبِيرٌ carries tested knowledge of the report and the case's interior.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The claim, testimony, and settlement carriers supply a matter whose interior must be known.
branch_activations.activation: Inward knowledge gives the legal sequence a basis deeper than an untested assertion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness relation can be embedded in a process that tests both report and underlying matter.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not collapse the human witness into the explicit final knower of 100:11.

findings.title: Surfaces that make a condition available
findings.claim: The focus witness can function as a condition-bearing indicator: a distinguishing mark, a visible complexion, and a reflected human image make an absent person or state available at the surface.
findings.mechanism: شَهِيدٌ supplies the sign-that-indicates facet; صُبْحًا supplies visible complexion, إِنسَانَ the human image in the pupil, and يَعْلَمُ the mark by which a thing becomes known. These contacts turn witnesshood into a system of readable surfaces.
findings.reader_payoff: The clause can be seen as describing how a hidden condition becomes knowable through what appears on the surface.
findings.containment: The ordinary witness remains the focus. The mark system is a contextual resonance and does not claim that complexion, pupil, or every form of knowing is literally named by شَهِيدٌ.

epistemic.reason: All four supplied branches have exact native carriers and a common surface-to-availability mechanism; the synthesis is bounded to the declared pericope.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin başka bir zaman, durum veya niteliğe belirti olarak işaret etmesi dalın çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus predicate carries a sign that points to a time, state, or quality.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding forms supply visible complexion, a reflected person, and the process of becoming known.
branch_activations.activation: The sign facet gives the three surface carriers one function: making an absent condition available.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood is readable as indication, not only as a speaking person's report.
branch_activations.boundary: The indicator reading does not displace the ordinary witness sense.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: the little human image in the pupil

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sign supplies the function of making a condition visible.
branch_activations.activation: The reflected image gives the indicator a concrete surface on which personhood appears.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A person can be available to recognition through an image carried by the eye.
branch_activations.boundary: The pupil image is a supplied extension, not the ordinary gloss of the human noun.

branch_activations.facet_statement: redness and bright beauty
branch_activations.carrier: صُبْحًا carries visible brightness and complexion.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus witness supplies the condition-indicating function.
branch_activations.activation: Visible complexion becomes a sign by which an underlying quality can be read.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness relation includes the body's visible disclosure of condition.
branch_activations.boundary: No moral or aesthetic judgment beyond the supplied visible-sign image is claimed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: a distinguishing mark that points to something
branch_activations.facet_statement: a distinguishing mark that points to something
branch_activations.carrier: يَعْلَمُ is supplied with a distinguishing-mark image that directs recognition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sign and the reflected person provide what the mark points toward.
branch_activations.activation: Knowing contacts marking as the movement from an appearing trace to recognized identity or state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The witness clause can make a visible sign legible as evidence of something beyond itself.
branch_activations.boundary: The evidence does not make the focus a literal road marker or banner.

findings.title: Concentrated witness in prepared provision
findings.claim: The focus witness can be placed within a prepared provision: preserved honey, thick syrup, solid curd, and welcome food form distinct contributions to one meal offered for arrival.
findings.mechanism: شَهِيدٌ supplies honey retained in comb; أَثَرْ supplies a dried-curd lump; رَبّ supplies thick syrup and treatment; and نَقْعًا supplies food prepared for an arrival. Their different material roles explain how a concentrated inner contribution belongs to a larger prepared provision.
findings.reader_payoff: The witness image gains material density: what is held within a bearer can be one part of a provision assembled for someone who arrives.
findings.containment: The ordinary witness assertion remains intact. This is a supplied food resonance, not a claim that the focus literally names honey, hospitality, or a meal.

epistemic.reason: The trusted reviewed evidence supplies exact food carriers with distinct complementary roles and a common prepared-provision mechanism.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Balmumu peteği içinde bulunan ve henüz süzülmemiş bal dalın çekirdeğidir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Witnesshood can be perceived as a preserved substance held ready within a larger offering.

branch_activations.facet_statement: a lump of dried curd

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The concentrated witness image belongs to a provision prepared for someone who comes into view.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal guest, slaughter, or milk is asserted in the focus clause.

findings.title: Expression as conflict's visible record
findings.claim: The focus expression can carry a hostile record: lineage attack and ugly abuse are verbalized, while anger appears in the face.
findings.mechanism: شَهِيدٌ supplies expressive language; قَدْحًا supplies impugning lineage, نَقْعًا supplies overwhelming abuse, and قُبُورِ carries the supplied nose-tip-in-anger idiom. The verbal and bodily carriers meet as two forms of conflict made visible.
findings.reader_payoff: Witnesshood becomes an expressive surface that can disclose not only facts but the force and posture of a conflict.
findings.containment: The ordinary witness remains present. The hostile-expression image does not accuse the focus subject of a separate insult, nor does it turn the graves context into an anger idiom by itself.

epistemic.reason: The reviewed evidence supplies a coherent expressive-and-bodily conflict mechanism with exact native carriers; the result is a bounded resonance.

branch_activations.activation: Expression provides the medium through which the conflict carriers become a witness-bearing surface.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus witness can disclose conflict through voice and visible posture.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus clause is not itself a literal insult.

branch_activations.facet_statement: the nose-tip in anger idioms

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus expression supplies the relation between outward display and what it reveals.
branch_activations.activation: The angered face gives verbal witnesshood a bodily counterpart.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Conflict can be witnessed in the posture of the face as well as in speech.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary grave reference remains available and is not replaced by the idiom.
